events.title: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration: Maker Guidelines
events.titleJa: Power Platform のガバナンスと管理: 作成者向けガイドラインを提供
events.titleEn: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration: Maker Guidelines
events.summary: The Maker guidelines feature gives organizations a direct way to share guidance with Copilot Studio makers in the flow of work. events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
events.titleJa: Copilot チャットのプランナー機能 (M365 Copilot)
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
events.summary: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.
events.summaryJa: M365 Copilot チャットで Planner タスクと Planner 情報をクエリする計画の作成をサポートし、ユーザーが Copilot と Planner の間でタスクと計画をシームレスに管理できるようにします。
events.summaryEn: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.

events.title: PowerPoint: Async Notifications for Copilot in PowerPoint
events.titleJa: PowerPoint での Copilot の非同期通知
events.titleEn: PowerPoint: Async Notifications for Copilot in PowerPoint
events.summary: Enable users to leave PowerPoint, switch devices, go offline, or end their workday while remaining confident that Copilot will notify them when work is complete or requires attention.
events.summaryJa: ユーザーは、作業が完了したときや注意が必要なときに Copilot から通知されることを確信しながら、PowerPoint から離れたり、デバイスを切り替えたり、オフラインになったり、勤務日を終了したりできます。
events.summaryEn: Enable users to leave PowerPoint, switch devices, go offline, or end their workday while remaining confident that Copilot will notify them when work is complete or requires attention.
